_metadata.source: FAO Soils Bulletin 55 & ICAR Regional Soil Classification
_metadata.validation_status: Pedological benchmark configuration (approximate physical hydraulic properties)

soils.name: Red Sandy Loam
soils.description: Southern Karnataka & Deccan plateau soil. Moderate water holding capacity, rapid percolation.
soils.advice: Best managed with drip irrigation applying short, frequent irrigation cycles.

soils.name: Clay / Black Soil
soils.description: High montmorillonite clay content (Vertisols). Excellent moisture retention, slow drainage.
soils.advice: Allow longer resting intervals between irrigation to prevent waterlogging and root hypoxia.

soils.name: Alluvial Loam
soils.description: Deep fertile river plain soil. Balanced water retention, good aeration, and high fertility.
soils.advice: Versatile soil suitable for surface drip or sprinkler systems.

soils.name: Sandy Soil
soils.description: Coarse structure with low available moisture storage. High risk of leaching.
soils.advice: Requires low-volume, high-frequency drip pulses to keep moisture in the active root zone.
